    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    AddForm
    The AddForm class provides static and instance utility methods to generate JavaFX user interface forms.
    Cli
    Command-line interface for the SmartFarm application.
    DelaunayTriangle
    Represents a Delaunay triangle.
    DelaunayTriangulation
    Implements the Bowyer-Watson algorithm to compute a Delaunay triangulation from a set of WaterTank points.
    DelaunayTriangulation.Edge
    Represents an undirected edge between two WaterTank vertices.
    ElementView
    The ElementView class serves as an abstract base for specialized view components that display technical data and properties of a specific element (like tools, sensors, or tanks) on the map.
    Field
    Represents a geographical or agricultural field defined by coordinate boundaries, an area, a name, and a collection of water plants.
    Ground
    Class representing an agricultural ground.
    Launcher
     
    MapView
    The MapView class manages the primary interactive dashboard and map view of the smart farm.
    NewGroundFormView
    The NewGroundFormView class handles the generation of JavaFX scenes dedicated to the multi-step creation of a new farm infrastructure.
    Person
    Represents a person with personal details such as name, age, email, and a unique system identifier. * @author Paul MORILLE
    Point
    Represents a specific point in a coordinate system, characterized by its x and y coordinates.
    Save
    Handles persistence of Ground objects by reading and writing plain-text save files.
    SaveView
    The SaveView class manages the user interface for browsing, selecting, and loading previously saved farm configuration files.
    SmartFarmUI
     
    Sprinkler
    Represents an automatic sprinkler positioned at specific coordinates.
    SprinklerView
    The SprinklerView class manages the graphical user interface display for a specific sprinkler element within the application.
    VoronoiBuilder
    Utility class for building a Voronoi diagram from a Delaunay triangulation, including clipping algorithms to constrain cells within ground boundaries.
    VoronoiCell
    Represents a Voronoi cell associated with a water tank tank.
    VoronoiDiagram
    Represents a Voronoi diagram generated from a set of water tanks.
    WaterTank
    Represents a water tank positioned at specific coordinates.
    WaterTankView
    The WaterTankView class handles the graphical user interface display for a specific water tank element within the application.
